newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Georg Fischer sets 133 mln Sfr conv bond.
newsitem.headline: Georg Fischer sets 133 mln Sfr conv bond.

text.p: Georg Fischer AG said it was issuing 133 million Swiss francs in six-year bonds convertible into bearer shares. The indicated coupon on the par-priced bonds is two percent.
Final terms will be announced on March 24. CSFB and UBS are joint lead managers. Pay date is April 25.
"The capital will be used for financing industrial core business development," it said in a statement.

Fischer shareholders will have non-negotiable prior subscription rights until March 21. Each bond at 5,700 franc par value requires 140 prior subscription certificates. One coupon number 23 per bearer share incorporates five prior subscription rights.
A separate certificate per registered share entitles the holder to one prior subscription right. Prior conscription rights can be combined.
The bonds can be converted free of charge at any time into three bearer shares.
"The interest rate on these bonds with an issue price of 100 percent will be approximately two percent. Conversion premium will be from 16 percent to maximum 20 percent," it said.
Public subscription starts on March 24 and lasts until 1100 GMT on March 27.
